purpose: PII-free scenario set for the same behavioral evaluation of Lucy control and HWS treatment.

scenarios.caller_prompt: I need a quote for a made-to-measure garage door for my home.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Qualify the estimate request and give the caller a confirmed next step.
required_behaviors: collect only the required name, postcode, phone_or_email, product_type and approximate_dimensions
ask one field at a time
repeat back captured fields and correct speech-to-text errors
do not quote an unsupported price or lead time
scenarios.acceptable_completion: Complete lead capture with read-back or make a correct lead handoff.

scenarios.caller_prompt: Can someone quote for a roller shutter at a commercial property?
scenarios.expected_outcome: Identify a commercial roller-shutter estimate and collect the minimum qualifying details.
required_behaviors: confirm product family and commercial context
capture approximate dimensions
state that final price and availability are project-dependent unless the source says otherwise
confirm the preferred follow-up channel
scenarios.acceptable_completion: Complete lead capture or correct transfer with context.

scenarios.caller_prompt: Do you supply automation systems powered by Somfy?
scenarios.expected_outcome: Answer only from the approved product source and offer a quote or transfer if the question becomes project-specific.
required_behaviors: use a grounded source answer
avoid inventing model compatibility or stock
ask a clarifying question before recommending a project-specific setup
scenarios.acceptable_completion: Grounded answer with an appropriate next step.

scenarios.caller_prompt: Where do you operate and when can I speak with someone?
scenarios.expected_outcome: Provide the approved service footprint and current answer/routing hours.
required_behaviors: use one reconciled schedule
distinguish answer hours from transfer availability when they differ
do not promise a weekend response if the route is closed
scenarios.acceptable_completion: Accurate location and hours answer or a clear after-hours next step.

scenarios.caller_prompt: I am already a distributor and need help with an order.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Recognize the distributor intent and transfer to the correct team with context.
required_behaviors: confirm the request is distributor-related
avoid sending the caller through the general quote flow
pass the reason and any non-sensitive order context to the receiving team
scenarios.acceptable_completion: Correct transfer to the Existing distributors destination or a reviewed fallback.

scenarios.caller_prompt: The door automation is not working and I need technical help.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Collect a concise issue description and transfer to technical support when the agent cannot safely resolve it.
required_behaviors: do not diagnose beyond approved source material
do not recommend unsafe electrical or mechanical actions
transfer with a concise problem summary
scenarios.acceptable_completion: Safe grounded guidance or correct Technical support transfer.

scenarios.caller_prompt: I have a billing question and need the accounts team.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Recognize billing intent and transfer to the correct destination without asking unnecessary sales questions.
required_behaviors: confirm billing or accounts intent
avoid requesting payment credentials
state what context will be passed
scenarios.acceptable_completion: Correct Billing and accounts transfer or reviewed fallback.

scenarios.caller_prompt: What is the exact price and delivery date for my door?
scenarios.expected_outcome: Explain that the answer depends on the project unless an approved current value exists, then collect details for a quote.
required_behaviors: do not invent price, availability or lead time
explain the quote-dependent boundary clearly
offer the qualifying next step
scenarios.acceptable_completion: Transparent limitation plus useful quote path.

scenarios.caller_prompt: My postcode and email are easy to mishear. Please read them back before you finish.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Capture and explicitly confirm high-risk fields, correcting any transcription uncertainty.
required_behaviors: read back postcode and email
spell or chunk characters when needed
ask for correction instead of silently accepting a low-confidence value
record completeness only after confirmation
scenarios.acceptable_completion: Confirmed accurate fields or a clear request for a human follow-up.

scenarios.caller_prompt: I would rather speak to a person.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Respect the request and transfer to the appropriate destination without resisting.
required_behaviors: ask only the minimum routing question
choose the correct context destination when known
use the reviewed fallback if the destination is unavailable
scenarios.acceptable_completion: Successful human transfer or transparent fallback.

scenarios.caller_prompt: I need something for the front of my building.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Ask a focused clarifying question instead of guessing the product or routing.
required_behaviors: clarify product type and residential_or_commercial context
avoid a long questionnaire
route to a quote path only after intent is clear
scenarios.acceptable_completion: Intent is narrowed and the next step is explicit.

scenarios.caller_prompt: It is the weekend and I need help now.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Use the reconciled weekend policy and provide an accurate after-hours option.
required_behaviors: do not claim a team is available when routing says closed
offer voicemail or next-business-day follow-up when approved
preserve recording and AI disclosure
scenarios.acceptable_completion: Accurate weekend handling with no false availability promise.
